title: Malicious code in @basis-theory-elements/api-client (npm)
description: The npm package @basis-theory-elements/api-client version 99.9.1 is identified as malicious. It declares a dependency as an HTTPS tarball URL rather than a versioned package, allowing arbitrary code execution during installation without integrity or publisher verification. The package name mimics a legitimate vendor scope and uses an implausibly high version number, consistent with dependency confusion attacks.
